title: Uploads are stored under the name the client sent
description: A file name such as ../../appsettings.pdf escapes the uploads folder, and two uploads with the same name overwrite each other.

title: The whole upload is copied into memory synchronously
description: CopyTo blocks a thread and buffers up to 10 MB per request before writing, instead of streaming to the file.

title: Path traversal in Download
description: id is combined into a path without any check, so ..\ sequences or an absolute path read any file the process can read.
